description: This file defines the ContentUrlTag class, which provides static utility methods to generate URL prefixes for content, handling secure and standard prefixes based on request attributes and configuration properties.

classes.name: ContentUrlTag
classes.description: Utility class providing static methods for constructing content URLs with proper prefixes based on request context and configuration.

methods.name: appendContentPrefix
methods.description: Appends the appropriate content URL prefix to a StringBuilder based on the request and site configuration.

methods.name: appendContentPrefix
methods.description: Appends the content URL prefix to a generic Appendable, considering whether the request is secure, and defaults to configuration properties if WebSite info is unavailable.

methods.name: getContentPrefix
methods.description: Returns the content URL prefix string for the given request.
